mapper.sql: SELECT e.* FROM expenses e INNER JOIN trips t ON t.id = e.trip_id AND t.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN trip_members membership ON membership.trip_id = t.id AND membership.user_id = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND membership.status = 'ACCEPTED' WHERE t.owner_id = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} OR membership.id IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: WITH accessible_expenses AS (), expense_totals AS ( SELECT currency, SUM(amount) AS total_spent FROM accessible_expenses GROUP BY currency ), split_summary AS ( SELECT e.currency, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.paid_by = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND e.paid_by_guest_member_id IS NULL AND es.is_settled = FALSE AND es.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} THEN es.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS owed_to_me, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN es.user_id = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND es.is_settled = FALSE AND e.paid_by IS DISTINCT FROM #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} THEN es.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS i_owe, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN es.user_id = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} THEN es.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS my_share, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN es.user_id = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND (e.paid_by = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} OR es.is_settled = TRUE) THEN es.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS my_paid FROM accessible_expenses e LEFT JOIN expense_splits es ON es.expense_id = e.id GROUP BY e.currency ) SELECT totals.currency, totals.total_spent, COALESCE(summary.owed_to_me, 0) AS owed_to_me, COALESCE(summary.i_owe, 0) AS i_owe, COALESCE(summary.my_share, 0) AS my_share, COALESCE(summary.my_paid, 0) AS my_paid FROM expense_totals totals LEFT JOIN split_summary summary ON summary.currency = totals.currency ORDER BY totals.currency

WITH accessible_expenses AS () SELECT currency, COALESCE(category::text, 'OTHER') AS category, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM accessible_expenses GROUP BY currency, COALESCE(category::text, 'OTHER') ORDER BY currency, amount DESC

WITH accessible_expenses AS () SELECT es.id AS split_id, e.id AS expense_id, e.trip_id, t.name AS trip_name, e.description AS expense_description, es.amount, e.currency, es.user_id AS counterpart_user_id, es.guest_member_id AS counterpart_guest_member_id, COALESCE(split_user.full_name, split_user.username, split_member.guest_name, es.guest_name, 'Guest') AS counterpart_display_name, split_user.avatar_url AS counterpart_avatar_url, e.created_at FROM accessible_expenses e INNER JOIN trips t ON t.id = e.trip_id INNER JOIN expense_splits es ON es.expense_id = e.id LEFT JOIN users split_user ON split_user.id = es.user_id LEFT JOIN trip_members split_member ON split_member.id = es.guest_member_id WHERE e.paid_by = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND e.paid_by_guest_member_id IS NULL AND es.is_settled = FALSE AND es.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, es.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH accessible_expenses AS () SELECT es.id AS split_id, e.id AS expense_id, e.trip_id, t.name AS trip_name, e.description AS expense_description, es.amount, e.currency, CASE WHEN e.paid_by_guest_member_id IS NULL THEN e.paid_by ELSE NULL END AS counterpart_user_id, e.paid_by_guest_member_id AS counterpart_guest_member_id, COALESCE(paid_user.full_name, paid_user.username, payer_member.guest_name, e.paid_by_guest_name, 'Guest') AS counterpart_display_name, paid_user.avatar_url AS counterpart_avatar_url, e.created_at FROM accessible_expenses e INNER JOIN trips t ON t.id = e.trip_id INNER JOIN expense_splits es ON es.expense_id = e.id LEFT JOIN users paid_user ON paid_user.id = e.paid_by AND e.paid_by_guest_member_id IS NULL LEFT JOIN trip_members payer_member ON payer_member.id = e.paid_by_guest_member_id WHERE es.user_id = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND es.is_settled = FALSE AND e.paid_by IS DISTINCT FROM #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, es.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH accessible_expenses AS (), paged_expenses AS ( SELECT * FROM accessible_expenses ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) SELECT e.id AS expense_id, e.trip_id, t.name AS trip_name, e.amount, e.currency, e.category, e.description, e.activity_id, CASE WHEN e.paid_by_guest_member_id IS NULL THEN e.paid_by ELSE NULL END AS paid_by_user_id, e.paid_by_guest_member_id, e.paid_by_guest_name, COALESCE(paid_user.full_name, paid_user.username, payer_member.guest_name, e.paid_by_guest_name, 'Guest') AS paid_by_display_name, paid_user.avatar_url AS paid_by_avatar_url, e.created_at, es.id AS split_id, es.user_id AS split_user_id, es.guest_member_id AS split_guest_member_id, es.guest_name AS split_guest_name, COALESCE(split_user.full_name, split_user.username, split_member.guest_name, es.guest_name, 'Guest') AS split_display_name, split_user.avatar_url AS split_avatar_url, es.amount AS split_amount, es.is_settled AS split_settled, es.settled_at AS split_settled_at FROM paged_expenses e INNER JOIN trips t ON t.id = e.trip_id LEFT JOIN users paid_user ON paid_user.id = e.paid_by AND e.paid_by_guest_member_id IS NULL LEFT JOIN trip_members payer_member ON payer_member.id = e.paid_by_guest_member_id LEFT JOIN expense_splits es ON es.expense_id = e.id LEFT JOIN users split_user ON split_user.id = es.user_id LEFT JOIN trip_members split_member ON split_member.id = es.guest_member_id ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC, es.id
WITH accessible_expenses AS () SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accessible_expenses
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense_payment_reminder_limits (sender_user_id, split_id, last_sent_at) VALUES (#{senderUserId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{splitId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{sentAt}) ON CONFLICT (sender_user_id, split_id) DO UPDATE SET last_sent_at = EXCLUDED.last_sent_at WHERE expense_payment_reminder_limits.last_sent_at <= #{cooldownStart}

INSERT INTO expense_payment_reminders (id, sender_user_id, recipient_user_id, expense_id, split_id, idempotency_key, created_at) VALUES (#{id,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{senderUserId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{recipientUserId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{expenseId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{splitId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdAt})
